meta.title: Ivory
meta.author: Teo
meta.description: Ivory by Teo, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from the release executable of Ivory (executable music, 4th at Revision 2015, scene.org `teo-ivory.zip`), unpacked with `upx -d` and carved by v2redux. 120 BPM, 3:18, 11 tracks. The V2 file's last tick is at 202:57; the song here ends 4 s after the last note (a note held more than 16 s past the last note-on is cut there). This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). Teo gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish his music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to him and is removed at his request.
